component.name: ProtonDrive Linux Client
component.summary: Unofficial open-source sync client for ProtonDrive on Linux

description.p: ProtonDrive Linux Client is an unofficial, open-source desktop sync client for ProtonDrive, built with GTK4 and Libadwaita. It uses Proton's official @protontech/drive-sdk — the same SDK Proton uses for their own CLI — ensuring long-term API compatibility.

Authenticate with your Proton account through an embedded browser window with full 2FA support. Set up one or more local folders to sync with ProtonDrive, with two-way sync, conflict detection, and automatic conflict copies.

The client handles real-world failure modes: offline change queuing with replay on reconnect, token expiry recovery without data loss, and actionable errors for disk full, permission denied, inotify limit exceeded, and file locked conditions.

description.p: Initial release of ProtonDrive Linux Client.

ul.li: Authenticate with your Proton account via an embedded browser — no manual token management
Set up and manage multiple local folders synced to ProtonDrive
Two-way file sync with conflict detection and automatic conflict copies
Offline resilience — changes queue while offline and replay automatically on reconnect
Token expiry recovery with a re-auth modal showing queued change count
Actionable error surfacing for disk full, permission denied, inotify limit, and file locked
Missing local folder detection with recovery prompt
